tool_input.description: Probe tool list and nested dispatch
tool_input.prompt:
Do this in order.

1. First, list the exact names of every tool you have available to you, one per line, exactly as the tool names appear.

2. Then use your Agent tool to dispatch one general-purpose subagent (subagent_type: "general-purpose", foreground). Give it this instruction: "Use your Bash tool to run this exact shell command, and report its output verbatim: printf dg-c9711b3a1684b741 | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16"

3. Report back to me: (a) the tool name list from step 1, and (b) the output the general-purpose subagent returned, verbatim. If you cannot use the Agent tool, say so plainly and give the reason you see.
